prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) archive_links and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [session_cookies]: Browser authentication sessions must use Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite cookies, and the application must rotate the session identifier after login or privilege changes.
Keep free-form prose and do not introduce structured field labels. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences.

SURFACE TASK
Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.

SOURCE PLAN
Normalize dest_path to an absolute base directory. Open tar_path and enumerate every member without extracting. For each member, compute its normalized extraction path under dest_path; abort and return False if any member would lie outside dest_path. For symbolic-link and hard-link members, additionally normalize the link target relative to the member’s parent directory and abort unless the resolved target remains inside dest_path. Validate every member and link before extracting any archive content. Once validation succeeds for all members, extract directories, files, and permitted links to their verified paths beneath dest_path, creating parent directories as needed. Return True if extraction completes successfully; otherwise return False, ensuring no archive member is ever written outside dest_path.
END_PLAN
